title.rendered: How to capture from a bond interface using PF_RING ZC?

content.rendered: Since PF_RING ZC is a kernel-bypass technology and the application directly access the network card, it is not possible to capture from a bond device, however you can aggregate traffic from multiple interfaces directly in ZC, see for example zbalance_ipc -i zc:ethX,zc:ethY
